Nearly flavorless, dry, and looks like a thick kitchen sponge. Solid blue green, no swirls of color at all.

The GOOD: good sized portion. Thick square, feels like I am eating a piece of cake. Has a light, pleasant flavor. Not overly flavored, hint of sweet. Low sodium, goodly amount of protein and fiber. It is when I go to swallow that I am concerned that I wont be able to finish swallowing. I have never experienced that with anything. Bite after bite, I found this true. I needed water or a cup of coffee to be able to comfortably swallow. Not cool. 1 star

My rating is primarily on how dry it is. I CAN NOT swallow this without also taking a sip of coffee. It is a choking hazard. Maybe my pack is bad, but others mention it in their reviews too. It is not just dry, but choking hazard dry. I am not sure if I have ever had something like that before. If it werent for that, I would rate this much higher. I like the blandness of flavor, the overall size. I dont even mind the odd look to it. I am not that picky! I WANT to like this. I love how they have many options, but since this is my first time trying something from this brand, I am reticent to buy a different option. If this simply had just a little more moisture (or fat), then I dont think it would feel like it is getting stuck in my throat. And it is only for this reason that my rating is centered around. Come back at me if the formula changes to something I can swallow. I'll probably work through this box- carefully with a cup of coffee.

user_history.review_text:
This is a huge portion of Medjool dates so I'll get the only drawback out of the way first. It comes in a large box with a plastic film over the top which will not keep air out once opened so you need to be sure to repackage them in less open packaging immediately. I portioned mine out and vacuumed sealed them. I think they'll probably hold their freshness for up to a year this way, but I think they'll dry out quickly unless you move them to a different package.

As for the quality of the dates, these are delicious. They have strong notes of brown sugar and are beautifully flavored without being too intense (some dates can have an off flavor which is too strong, these do not). The texture is plump, moist, and appropriately chewy. They aren't too fibrous, though there is variability in that point across the box. Most of the dates are quite large, but some are on the smallish side (though none are actually small).

They are some of the best dates I've ever had and are great just for snacking though I plan to try them in baking as well. I will note that they still have their seeds, but I think that is a good point since it helps them stay fresher. The pits are easy to remove though, as are the little stems at the ends.
